steps.text: Bring a rope, a shovel and health potions or fluids.
steps.source: Required Equipment: Rope, Shovel, Small Health Potions, 2 Antidote Potions.

steps.text: Dig the middle grave north-east of the island open with your shovel and go down (spiders, a poison spider).
steps.source: Go to the graves to the north-east of the island (Mapper Coords 125.151, 125.151, 7), and open the middle down one with a Shovel.

steps.text: Follow the way west to the hole and jump in.
steps.source: Follow the path west to a hole and jump into it.

steps.text: Go north past the rotworms: key 4603 is in the dead body.
steps.source: To get Key 4603 face north. Key 4603 will be hidden in one of the dead bodies. When you find it, go back south.

steps.text: Go back south and down the hole to the east (a skeleton).
steps.source: Go east from the poison fields, into a hole. Down the hole resides a single Skeleton.

steps.text: Open the door with key 4603 and take the stairs down. Careful: skeletons and a rotworm may be in the room below (the lever behind the north white pillar opens its door).
steps.source: Open the door with Key 4603, and take the stairs down. If the door is unlocked there could be two skeletons and a rotworm in this room. There is a hidden lever behind the northern white pillar.

steps.text: In the fresh corpse: a viking helmet.
steps.source: The treasure is hidden inside the fresh human corpses. Grab your Viking Helmet and Katana.

steps.text: In the other corpse: the katana. If someone closes the door, the teleporter takes you out.
steps.source: If someone closes the door with the lever from the outside, go to the teleport for you to get out!
